dashboard.label: TA-memwatch Overview
dashboard.description: Collects early-warning memory signals from /proc/meminfo, /proc/vmstat and /proc/slabinfo: available-memory percentage, swap usage, cumulative swap-in/out counters, cumulative

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-memwatch" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

single.option: key beacon within 3h - enter a key on the License page

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-memwatch. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-memwatch requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-memwatch", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-memwatch/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
| mstats avg("memwatch.mem_available_pct") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("memwatch.swap_used_pct") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats sum("memwatch.oom_new") as value where index=metrics span=5m | stats sum(value) as value
| mstats avg("memwatch.slab_top_kb") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="memwatch:status" | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=x path=top_slabs{} | where isnotnull(x) AND x!="" | mvexpand x | spath input=x | table host name kb
